title: NFTokenBurn::preclaim should explicitly reject burn when issuer account SLE is absent
key_points: In NFTokenBurn::preclaim, the permission check silently falls through to tesSUCCESS if the issuer's account has been deleted (SLE is null).
The defensive fix is trivial: return tecNO_PERMISSION (or tecINTERNAL) when sle is null.
No exploit is possible as AccountDelete::preclaim blocks deletion when sfMintedNFTokens != sfBurnedNFTokens.
limitations: Only applicable to the NFTokenBurn::preclaim function.
asserts: The source claims that in NFTokenBurn::preclaim, when a non-owner attempts to burn a burnable NFT and the issuer's account has been deleted (SLE is null), the permission check should explicitly reject the transaction.
scope: The scope of this assertion is limited to the NFTokenBurn::preclaim function within the NFTokenBurn.cpp source file in the libxrpl/tx/transactors/nft directory of the XRPLF/rippled repository.
